advisorTitle: A clearer way to find your place.
advisorIntro: Describe the life you have in mind. I’ll clarify what matters, compare only the catalogue’s available entries, and show where evidence or information is missing.
advisorModeDisclosure: This is structured, deterministic assistance—not a live AI service, market model, or human advisor. It uses documented fields from VELORA’s fictional catalogue.
advisorSessionOnly: Your messages stay in memory for this page session. Nothing is sent to a service or saved in browser storage. Reset clears the consultation.
advisorWelcomeTitle: Start with the life you have in mind.
advisorWelcomeCopy: We can begin with an intention, or with the details that matter most. There is no fixed questionnaire.
advisorStartPrompt: Choose a starting point, or describe your needs in your own words.
advisorBriefEmpty: Your preferences will take shape here as you describe them. Nothing has been assumed yet.
advisorBriefComplete: No material details are currently open.
advisorEditHint: Correct a detail in the conversation, or remove it here. Stated facts and inferred preferences are identified separately.
advisorFinancialUnknown: Financial performance data is not available
advisorRelaxedNote: One or more requirements were relaxed at your request. The resulting trade-offs are shown with each option.
advisorResetLabel: Clear this consultation and start a new one
advisorComposeLabel: Add a thought or correct a detail
advisorPlaceholder: For example: A quiet home for my family, with room outdoors, but not far from downtown…
advisorInputHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line · 1,000 characters maximum
advisorResponseError: I couldn’t update the consultation just now. Your existing brief is unchanged; please try again.
advisorNoResultsKeptStrict: I have not relaxed any of the requirements you marked as non-negotiable.
advisorNoRecommendations: No options have been ranked yet; we can keep refining the brief.
advisorDataNote: Fictional catalogue · illustrative asking prices, attributes and travel times
advisorNoLiveData: The properties, prices, locations, distances, features and availability shown here are illustrative demo records—not live offers or market data.
advisorModeNote: No external model or data source is connected. This experience does not make calls on your behalf.
advisorSessionNote: Conversation text is held in memory only and is not stored after reset or reload.
advisorNotFinancialAdvice: This is property discovery, not financial, legal or tax advice.
advisorOrderNote: A deterministic comparison of stated preferences and documented catalogue fields. Missing fields are neutral—not positive evidence. No percentage or machine-learning score is shown; listed price breaks ties.
advisorPriorityOrder: Ranked by a deterministic comparison of the preferences that can be checked. Missing fields count as neutral, not as a match. This is not a model, percentage or market recommendation; listed price breaks ties.
advisorBudgetOnlyOrder: Every option shown satisfies the stated budget condition. When preferences do not distinguish them, the lower illustrative asking price is shown first; this is not a value assessment.
advisorResponseReady: I compared the catalogue entries marked available against the details you shared. Each reason below points to a recorded field; compromises and unknowns remain visible.
advisorResponseNeedMore: That gives me a starting point. I’ll ask only for a detail that could change the comparison; anything you have not stated remains open.
advisorResponseNoResults: No available catalogue entry meets every requirement you made non-negotiable. I have kept those requirements intact.
advisorResponseScope: I can help clarify property preferences and compare the facts in this catalogue. Describe what matters in a home; I will not fill gaps with assumptions.
advisorResponseInvestment: I can compare listed price, size, location, property type and documented features. This catalogue contains no rent, operating costs, yield, occupancy, transaction or resale data, so I cannot assess financial performance or returns.
advisorResponsePrivacy: The catalogue does not document household privacy measures. I will not infer them from a confidential-listing flag or a “quiet” tag.
advisorResponseNoBudget: I have left price unrestricted as you asked. The illustrative asking price remains visible, and the ranking uses only the other preferences we can check.
advisorResponseUpdated: I’ve updated that detail and kept the rest of your brief.
advisorResponseEmpty: Write a preference or choose a starting point to begin.
advisorResponseReset: The consultation has been cleared. Start with an intention or describe what matters; nothing from the previous brief was saved.
advisorResponseUnsupportedCurrency: Catalogue prices are in AED. I have not converted or applied the currency you mentioned. Share a range in AED, or continue without a budget.
advisorAskPrimary: What should shape day-to-day life most: a quieter setting, outdoor space, or a shorter listed journey to downtown?
advisorAskBudget: Would you like to share an indicative budget in AED, or should I leave price open?
advisorAskInvestmentFocus: For this investment exploration, are you thinking about long-term ownership, rental income, or resale flexibility? The catalogue cannot assess returns.
advisorAskQuietCity: You value both quiet and city access. Which should lead if the available options involve a trade-off?
advisorAskBedrooms: How many bedrooms would comfortably meet your needs? You can also keep that flexible.
advisorAskPrivacy: The catalogue has no verified home-privacy measure. Would you like to use its “quiet” tag as a limited proxy, or leave privacy unranked?
advisorAskRefine: Would you like to relax one requirement to explore alternatives? I will keep it strict unless you choose.
advisorQuickUseQuiet: Use the quiet tag as a limited proxy
